about: OH's director script: the 16 beats as data the demo kit's director runs (public/demo-kit/director.js), scaffolded by scripts/demo-kit/new-demo.mjs from demo.config.json. Not a published beat document: those are beats/*.json, which scripts/demo-kit/seed.mjs re-anchors and the worker applies by name. Strings are templates over the facts oh.js computes (facts()); run lists are the kit's verbs; call is the one escape hatch into oh.js. A beat whose run is notBuilt says so on the status line and stops: its presses are its lane's to write.

beats.label: A stranger arrives from search
declare: {{#region.override}}Rehearsal override: region = {{region.override}} from the address bar (?region=), asserted and labelled{{/region.override}}{{^region.override}}Her region comes from the request: the edge locates her, and nothing is asserted{{/region.override}}
will: The hero and the deals answer the search and her region: the campaign term seeds TV, her state’s sales lean the rest

The Arrival panel names {{#region.override}}the override’s region, labelled as asserted{{/region.override}}{{^region.override}}the region the edge located, from the request{{/region.override}}, the census (shown, never scored) and the regional lean, labelled synthetic → warehouse
Her own meters are empty: nothing about her is known yet
beats.line: A stranger searches “{{arrival.term}}” and lands. The first paint answers the search and where she is: {{#region.override}}her region is a rehearsal override, labelled{{/region.override}}{{^region.override}}her region comes from the request{{/region.override}}{{#region.lean}}, and her state’s sales lean {{region.lean}}{{/region.lean}}. The census is shown, never scored; Compare sets the site’s own page beside it.

beats.label: The same page, another state
declare: Asserts {{region.contrastName}} on the request, labelled: not observed
will: A different state’s lean on the same stranger: the hero and the deals answer {{region.contrastName}}’s sales
The Arrival panel says the region is asserted, not observed
beats.line: The same stranger and the same page, in {{region.contrastName}}: asserted and labelled, never the opening default. Another state’s sales lean the page another way; the price is the same for everyone.

note: the contrast: asserted on the request, labelled · not observed

beats.label: Two TVs, then a washer
declare: Opens two TV pages, then a front-load washer’s
will: room and type rise on her own meters; the room tiles reorder; the rail across rooms balances them
beats.line: She opens two TVs, then a front-load washer, and the homepage changes with her, receipts behind every card: room and type rise, the room tiles reorder, the rail across rooms balances.

run.what: she opens two TVs, then a front-load washer

beats.label: The fresh visitor beside her
declare: Compare: her page against a stranger’s, in the same region
will: Her page and a fresh visitor’s, side by side: the same region’s prior, and what her visit earned
beats.line: Compare: her page against a stranger’s in the same region. The same catalog and the same public prices; only what she did is different.

beats.label: The washer page
will: Below the buy box: the dryer in her fuel, the pedestal, the stacking kit, the pair price
“Goes with” is shown as a merchandiser’s rule, on the receipt
beats.line: The washer page. Below the buy box, which nobody decides, the room completes: the dryer in her fuel, the pedestal, the stacking kit and the pair price, each a merchandiser’s rule with its receipt.

beats.label: She switches to a top-loader
will: The pedestal leaves, and its card says why: a top-loader takes none
beats.line: She switches to a top-loader and the pedestal leaves: a rule withdrawing itself, with its reason on the card.

beats.label: The TV page
will: The soundbar for the series and the mount for the VESA pattern
beats.line: The TV page: the soundbar matched to its series and the mount for its VESA pattern. The same engine, a different room.

beats.label: The range page
will: The over-the-range microwave, the dishwasher, and the package price when it is lower
beats.line: The kitchen path: the range, the microwave above it, the dishwasher beside it, and the package when it costs less than the three.

beats.label: QNED beside OLED, a size up
declare: Opens a QNED page with the OLED beside it, and a size up from her viewing distance
will: Tier and size band move on her meters; the price is the same for everyone
beats.line: A QNED page with the OLED beside it, and a size up from her viewing distance: tier and size band move. The price is the same for everyone, and nothing decided sits near the financing line.

run.what: a QNED page, with the OLED beside it; a size up from her viewing distance

beats.label: She enters a closet width
declare: Enters the width of her laundry closet
will: Models that do not fit drop out, and the page counts them: hidden, wider than your space
beats.line: She enters her closet’s width, and the models that would not fit drop out, counted on the page: hidden, wider than your space.

beats.label: An offer’s window closes
declare: Publishes the catalog: the gift-card offer’s window has closed, with the offers that close with it
will: The closed offer and the out-of-stock package leave every surface on the next decision
beats.line: The merchandiser’s day: an offer’s window closes, and a package loses a member to stock. Both leave every surface on the next decision, by the catalog’s own rules.

run.name: {{beatNames.windowCloses}}
run.reason: an offer’s window closes; a package member is out of stock

beats.label: The merchandiser pins a launch
declare: Pins a launch-series offer into the deals, for everyone
will: The pin leads the deals; its receipt shows what the engine would have chosen
beats.line: The merchandiser pins a launch series. The pin leads, and its receipt says so: the merchandiser outranks the engine, visibly.

run.name: {{beatNames.pinLaunch}}
run.reason: pin a launch series into the deals

beats.label: Three weeks later
declare: Three weeks pass, labelled: every window moves back {{clock.days}} days in one publish, and her dials are read three weeks on
will: Laundry interest faded faster than TV, by the dials; the continue hero answers her return
beats.line: Three weeks later, labelled as a clock jump: every window moves back {{clock.days}} days, and her dials are read three weeks on. Laundry faded faster than TV, by the published memory, and the homepage picks up where she left off.

run.name: {{beatNames.threeWeeks}}
run.reason: three weeks pass: every window moves back 21 days

run.what: the labelled clock jump on her dials, and the continue hero

beats.label: What changed while she was away
will: The shortlist’s deltas: a price that changed, a model that arrived
beats.line: What changed while she was away: the price that moved on her shortlist and the model that arrived since. The page says what changed; the price itself is the catalog’s.

run.what: the price that changed, the model that arrived

beats.label: The phone, then sign-in
declare: Opens the site on her phone: a stranger
Signs in as {{signIn.account}}, a fictional account; the worker mints the signed link
will: The phone becomes the laptop’s taste in one request: linked at sign-in, consented, no device matching
beats.line: On her phone she is a stranger until she signs in as {{signIn.account}}: then the phone becomes the laptop’s taste in one request. Linked at sign-in and consented; no device matching.

run.what: the phone: a stranger, then sign-in (live, a fictional account; the worker mints the signed link)

beats.label: Best Buy counts
declare: Chooses Best Buy pickup on one page and Find a Retailer on another
will: Two named outcomes in the day report, with attach and attribution, and “not yet significant”
beats.line: Best Buy pickup on one page, Find a Retailer on another, and the day report counts both as named outcomes, with attach and attribution. Not yet significant, and it says so: attribution, not incrementality.

run.what: she presses Best Buy pickup on one page and Find a Retailer on another; the day report
